capabilities: extract bold text from the active editor
convert extracted text into HTML input fields
answer in a modal and check answers in real time
reveal answers via a Hint button
customize input box border and background colors
extras: Workflow assumes notes where key points are underlined and then written as bold text; no examples of note format are given.
motivation: The author built it to make self-testing quick and easy so learners repeat it and feel less stressed, based on the retrieval practice technique from The Study Algorithm.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in quick way to quiz yourself on note content for retrieval practice and long-term memory.
summary: Self-testing plugin that extracts bold text from a note and turns it into fill-in-the-blank input fields checked in real time.
